left.raw_text: 1. For individuals undergoing blister or skin biopsy procedures, history of keloid formation.

right.raw_text: 2. Current or prior (within 3 months) anticoagulant or anti-platelet therapy (other than aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs [NSAIDs]).

left.raw_text: 3. Current or prior (within 3 months) use of immunomodulatory drugs (e.g., chemotherapy, steroids), except if approved by the principal investigator.

right.raw_text: 5. Any condition that, in the opinion of the investigator, contraindicates participation in the study.
